pages.title: Server-authoritative
pages.text:
All timing values (durations, cooldowns, windup, particle level) are decided by the $(l)server$() and synced to clients, so on a multiplayer server what you see is what the server actually uses.

Editable in singleplayer, read-only elsewhere.

pages.title: Reloading
pages.text:
$(c)/chm reload$() reloads both the main and maid configs (permission level 2).

$(italic)$(c)blocked_mods$() is not hot-reloadable — it's read during mod init, so restart after changing it. $()

pages.title: In-game GUI
pages.text:
With Cloth Config installed, the config button in the mod list edits the same settings, one category per TOML section.

$(italic)The maid page needs both Cloth Config and Touhou Little Maid. $()
